zotero.abstractNote: In this paper, we introduce BO-Arena: an actively maintained software package for simple, efficient and reliable benchmarking of high-dimensional Bayesian optimisation. Benchmarking practices in high-dimensional Bayesian optimisation often fail to ensure strong baselines and correct implementations, leading to a lack of reproducibility and comparability. BO-Arena addresses these issues by providing a standardised, extensible, and easy-to-use framework for evaluating Bayesian optimisation algorithms.
